notes.title: Update 3
notes.notes: Another tiny update. Added a button to quit the game after completion. I believe the game will get more tiny updates in the future. Please let me know about stuff you think I should add to the game. Thanks!

notes.title: Update 2
notes.notes: Bug fix on the calculator. I've also watched some gameplay on Youtube and have simplified a certain point in the game where everyone got stuck.

notes.title: Update 1 - Bug fixes
notes.notes:
Hey, first update is live!

I've fixed a game breaking bug with the Caluclator, and added an easy fullscreen switch using ESC or F4.

Thanks for checking out my game!
